2609.30199.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
2609.30199.paper_summary: Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.
2609.30199.paper_summary_zh: 科學發現始於已知問題的終結。<lb/>在那裡，AI 系統必須進行探索：框定假設、設計實驗並對結果進行迭代。<lb/>然而，評估這種能力是困難的：(1) 如何驗證一個真正的新假設是否成立，以及 (2) 如何確定一個系統是通過探索發現它還是僅僅從預訓練數據中回憶相關知識。<lb/>為此，我們引入了 ExplorationBench，將評估科學探索的棘手問題轉化為一個具體且可處理的框架，該框架建立在可驗證的 Alien Worlds 之上：它們的規則是可執行的，因此每個答案都可以準確檢查，並且它們與熟悉的知識相衝突，因此僅僅依賴回憶無法解決這些任務。<lb/>該基準包含兩個沙盒，AlienCode（31 個發現目標，70 個任務）和 AlienLogic（24 個發現目標，70 個任務）。<lb/>每個沙盒提供一個有缺陷的手冊、特定任務的環境反饋以及專用的工具調用架構。<lb/>系統使用這些資源來探索沙盒，然後解決保留的任務。<lb/>我們評估了 10 個 AI 系統，發現最強的系統能夠獲取並應用不熟悉的規則，而表現則在不同的軌跡中有顯著變化，持續探索可能會停滯或逆轉早期的增長。<lb/>ExplorationBench 代表了邁向能夠通過探索在未知環境中獲取和應用真正新知識的 AI 系統的一步。
